ticket.summary: Split braided supply hose under kitchen sink was spraying; customer closed the fixture shutoff and leak is contained — needs supply line replacement, kitchen sink out of service until repaired.
mitigation_advice: Closed the kitchen sink supply shutoff valve (clockwise until snug) to stop the spray [PB-01]
Keep the fixture valve closed and do not use the kitchen faucet until repaired [PB-01]

quote_lines.description: Replace split braided supply line at kitchen faucet connection

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Dana — booked for tomorrow, Tuesday Sept 1 at 8:00 AM. Keep the shutoff valve closed and don't use the kitchen faucet until the tech replaces the hose; the rest of the house is fine. If anything starts spraying again overnight, text or call and we'll page the on-call plumber. Quote: $129 flat for the supply line replacement, ~45 minutes; if the shutoff valve is corroded we'd confirm with you before adding $139.
